[[Illyana's Mirror]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[The Darkness (boss)|The Darkness]]es, [[boss]]es in the [[The Hall of Heroes (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]])
:Reduces [[Deep Wound]] duration on you by 20% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Shadestone]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Fast Casting]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Gilded Artifact]] from collector [[Ivarr Stewbrewer]]
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from [[collector]] [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength of Body]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Fast Casting]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Gilded Artifact]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)

==Trivia==
*Because of the [[The Darkness|monster]] that this unique item comes from, the name 'Illyana' may be a reference to a Marvel comic book series titled [[w:Magik_(Illyana_and_Storm)|Magik (Illyana and Storm)]].
